newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Five Belgians killed in Eritrea ambush.
newsitem.headline: Five Belgians killed in Eritrea ambush.

text.p: Five Belgians have been killed in an ambush in Eritrea, the Belgian Foreign Ministry said on Monday.

A ministry spokesman, confirming a report on Eritrean radio, told Reuters that one Belgian man and four Belgian women from Leuven, central Belgium, were on an outing close to the Eritrean village of Filfil when they were attacked on Friday.
Their Eritrean driver was also killed, he said.
"We do not know who attacked them or why. We think the attackers were bandits," the spokesman said.
He declined to give the names of the five who, he said, appeared to be on a tourist trip in the country.
The victims' families have been informed.
